<!-- Generated by doc-sync-agent.py; sources: loadup-components/data/loadup-components-dfs/README.md, loadup-components/data/loadup-components-dfs/ARCHITECTURE.md -->

Business code injects `DfsTemplate`. Each binder registers its own implementation.

## Maven

Import the LoadUp BOM, then add `loadup-components-dfs-api` and exactly one binder:

```xml
<dependency>
  <groupId>io.github.loadup-cloud</groupId>
  <artifactId>loadup-components-dfs-api</artifactId>
</dependency>
<dependency>
  <groupId>io.github.loadup-cloud</groupId>
  <artifactId>loadup-components-dfs-binder-s3</artifactId>
</dependency>
```

## Configuration

Select a binder by its identifier in `loadup.dfs.binder-type`. The built-in binders use `local`, `s3`, and `database`.
Each additional binder supplies its own identifier. Binder-specific settings live under `loadup.dfs.binder.<type>`.

```yaml
loadup:
  dfs:
    binder-type: s3
    binder.s3.bucket: loadup-files
    binder.s3.region: us-east-1
```

## Capabilities

| Capability                                 | local | s3 | database |
|--------------------------------------------|------:|---:|---------:|
| Upload, download, delete, exists, metadata |    ✓ | ✓ |       ✓ |
| Metadata survives process restart          |    ✓ | ✓ |       ✓ |
| Presigned download URL                     |    ✗ | ✓ |       ✗ |
| Multipart upload                           |    ✗ | ✓ |       ✗ |

S3 is the recommended production binder. Local is for development and single-node deployments; database is a
transitional small-file binder.

<a id="architecture"></a>
## 设计与实现

Each binder directly implements and registers `DfsTemplate`.

```text
Business code → DfsTemplate implementation → storage system
```

Each binder declares its own `loadup.dfs.binder-type` value. Optional consumers such as File evaluate their bean conditions after
`DfsAutoConfiguration`. Each binder orders its auto-configuration before that shared point.

The S3 binder uses AWS SDK `S3Client` and `S3Presigner`, persists user metadata as object metadata, supports presigned
GET URLs, and exposes the S3 multipart lifecycle. It accepts AWS S3, MinIO, OSS, COS, and LocalStack through endpoint
and path-style settings.

The local binder stores objects and sidecar metadata below the configured root. The database binder stores small objects
and JSON metadata in `dfs_file`, using Spring JDBC and explicit audit fields. Database storage is retained as a
transitional implementation and is not the production default.

Download responses implement `AutoCloseable`; callers must close them after consuming the stream. Binders own their
clients and never expose SDK types through the facade.

### 分层与调用路径

预签名与分片操作取决于所选 binder 的能力。

```text
loadup-components-dfs
  └─ loadup-components-dfs-api
  └─ loadup-components-dfs-binder-database
  └─ loadup-components-dfs-binder-local
  └─ loadup-components-dfs-binder-s3
```

聚合 POM 组织模块与版本，运行时依赖由子模块决定。
各 binder 在自己的 `src/test` 中验证存储行为；本地 binder 也覆盖 DFS 服务契约。
数据库和 S3 集成测试分别通过 Testcontainers 启动 PostgreSQL 和 LocalStack。

### 设计取舍

聚合层只表达模块组合和依赖方向，实际能力由选定的子模块提供。

集成方式与配置示例见 [README.md](./)。
